Package com.agrialert.ui.fields

Class AddFieldFragment

java.lang.Object
androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
com.agrialert.ui.fields.AddFieldFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
android.content.ComponentCallbacks, android.view.View.OnCreateContextMenuListener, androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultCaller, androidx.lifecycle.HasDefaultViewModelProviderFactory, androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner, androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner, androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
public class AddFieldFragment extends androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
Fragment for adding a new agricultural field to the system. It allows users to specify an address (via manual input or map interaction), select a crop type, and assign the field to a group.

    • loadCurrentLocation

      private void loadCurrentLocation()
      Retrieves the device's current geographic location using the Mapbox Location Service. If the location is successfully retrieved, it performs reverse geocoding to obtain the physical address, updates the address input field, centers the map on the location, and places a marker.
